/**
 * KAOS event indexer — Cloudflare Worker (cron-triggered).
 *
 * Runs every 5 minutes (see wrangler.toml `[triggers] crons`). Reads
 * new trigger events from the KAOS token contract since the last
 * indexed block, then writes aggregated data to the KAOS_STATS KV
 * namespace so the Pages Functions can serve it without hitting the
 * RPC on every request.
 *
 * KV keys written:
 *   lastBlock            — last indexed block number (string)
 *   recentEvents         — last 200 trigger events (JSON array)
 *   leaderboard          — top 100 players by total payout (JSON array)
 *   stats:totalBurned    — cumulative KAOS burned (string, wei)
 *   stats:totalPayouts   — cumulative KAOS paid out (string, wei)
 *   stats:triggerCounts  — { triggerName: count } (JSON object)
 *
 * Free-tier budget: KV allows 1,000 writes/day. At one run every 5
 * minutes that's 288 runs/day. To stay under the limit we always
 * write `lastBlock` (1 write) and only write the aggregated keys
 * when there are new events. On an idle chain that's 288 writes/day;
 * when events exist it's up to 6 writes/run, which is fine because
 * active windows are far fewer than 288/day in practice. If KAOS
 * becomes extremely active, consider widening the cron interval.

sections.title: Astro 5 static pages hydrate React 19 islands for live data
sections.content: The site is Astro 5 static-first. Static sections (Hero, TriggerTable, Tokenomics, HowToPlay, Footer) render at build time; interactive widgets (LivePots, TriggerFeed, Leaderboard) are React 19 islands that hydrate client-side and read chain data via viem.

sections.title: Contract addresses in constants.ts are placeholders until deploy
sections.content: src/lib/constants.ts carries contract addresses, the RPC URL, and socials. Addresses must be updated after the KAOS contract deploys to Base.

sections.title: Hosting is Cloudflare Pages free tier with edge functions
sections.content: The site deploys to Cloudflare Pages. Historical leaderboard data is served by Pages Functions backed by KV, populated by a cron indexer worker every 5 minutes.

sections.title: Key files: constants, abi, triggers, contract
sections.content: src/lib/constants.ts = addresses/RPC/socials; src/lib/abi.ts = minimal ABIs; src/lib/triggers.ts = 21-trigger metadata; src/lib/contract.ts = viem client and fetchers; IMPLEMENTATION.md = 5-phase feature plan.

sections.title: The kaos contracts repo is the source of truth for ABIs
sections.content: Trigger data, contract ABIs, and deployment addresses come from ~/dev/remedy/kaos. The website mirrors them; the contracts repo owns them.

sections.title: Twenty-one trigger types are defined in src/lib/triggers.ts
sections.content: Trigger metadata — name, modulo, odds, tier — lives in src/lib/triggers.ts. The kaos contracts repo is the source of truth for trigger semantics and contract ABIs.

sections.title: On-chain reads go through viem 2
sections.content: src/lib/contract.ts holds the viem client plus read functions and event fetchers. src/lib/abi.ts carries minimal ABIs for the KAOS ERC20 contract on Base.

sections.title: E2E coverage uses Playwright specs
sections.content: test/e2e has browser, screenshot, and DOM-content specs; component tests live in test/components and contract tests in test/integration.

sections.title: A cron worker indexes historical data every 5 minutes
sections.content: workers/indexer.ts feeds Cloudflare KV so Pages Functions can serve the all-time leaderboard without querying the chain per request.
